node.title: One shared shifted-core budget for original compression fibre weights
node.statement: For an actual weighted pair family enclosed by f_*+H_a*((delta tensor U) direct_sum Fz), original degree<K and complete cores>=A>K-1, the shifted fibre core-union masses x_c=|C_c|-K+1 are positive and sum<=n-K+1. Scalar LIST caps on actual fibre spans give total raw weight<=t+(n-K+1) sup_x ((n-K+1-x)L(x)/x). The common preferred slope is charged once, and only pair differences and auxiliary domains are divided. All cross-fibre overlaps use the ORIGINAL annihilator H_a rho(z).
